title: Upper Kula water transmission line improvements
summary: Bill 166 would add $350,000 for upper Kula water transmission improvements, funded from estimated Department of Water Supply license and permit revenues. A council member noted two diversions were destroyed in 2018 by Hurricane Olivia. Earlier, in December 2024, the Mālama Kula leader said large tree trunks lie in a Kula gulch near the transmission line, and a council member said preventing main line damage costs far less than recovery.
